crossRefs.note: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.
If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

translations.web: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus said to the man who had invited Him, “When you host a dinner or a banquet, do not invite your friends or brothers or relatives or rich neighbors. Otherwise, they may invite you in return, and you will be repaid.
translations.kjv: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
translations.asv: And he said to him also that had bidden him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, nor thy kinsmen, nor rich neighbors; lest haply they also bid thee again, and a recompense be made thee.
